text:
Priya: heads-up — StellarCloud is requesting eu-west-3 Dedicated SKU availability for a co-launch next quarter. Can we confirm capacity, KMS flow, and marketplace timing?
Miguel: quick check: current quota shows room for ~12 p4d-equivalent nodes but need to carve a reserved pool for partner. noisy-neighbor mitigation will be needed.
Sasha (StellarCloud): partner requests 4 reserved nodes with burst to 12 during launch week. They need BYOK KMS plus fallback and audit log export to their SIEM.
Priya: list of must-haves: reserve 4 nodes, burst to 12, KMS BYOK + test key, 7y audit logs retention, marketplace listing + joint announcement.
Miguel: I'll open infra ticket to provision nodepool + CIDR + retention flags.
jenkins-bot: pipeline queued: nodepool-provisioner pr#482.
Miguel: created ticket INC-8342 (https://redwood-infra/ops/INC-8342) — includes nodepool carve, sandbox CIDR, KMS entitlement, retention flag.
Sasha (StellarCloud): KMS spec uploaded: gist.github.com/stellarcloud/kms-flow-2026. rotation 90 days, wrap/unwrap, and SIEM logs required.
Daniel: legal will need a DP appendix for EU-only handling and the marketplace T&Cs. I can draft; need it by Apr 20 to hit May soft-launch.
Mark (Partner Ops): confirmed MSA signed and uploaded (https://drive.redwood/partners/stellarcloud/msa-signed.pdf). Partner still needs the marketplace asset checklist and joint press draft.
Priya: proposed rollout: internal canary 4/30, partner beta 5/6, GA 5/12. Beta gives SI time for integration testing.
Sasha (StellarCloud): SI team scheduled integration tests 5/6-5/10. They need sandbox nodepool and test KMS key. Raj from SI joining thread.
Raj (Stellar SI): ping — we'll start planning integration tests tomorrow, need access to sandbox creds and test key.
Miguel: sandbox CIDR reserved 10.40.32.0/24 after INC-8342 approval. Ops to enable 7y retention flag.
Daniel: I'll post DP appendix draft by Apr 11 for review.
Priya: action items: Miguel — infra ticket (done), Miguel/ops — enable retention + provide sandbox, Daniel — DP appendix, Sasha — final KMS cert + SI test plan, Mark — confirm marketplace assets, Priya + marketing — press draft by Apr 18.
Mark (Partner Ops): I'll coordinate webinar logistics with Stellar post-press draft. Partner ops will co-host.
Sasha (StellarCloud): pinged Raj in DM; gist with SI test matrix shared.
jenkins-bot: INC-8342 updated: nodepool provisioning + KMS entitlement + retention flag.
Priya: thanks all — I'll close when items are green. tagging @Miguel @Daniel @Mark @Sasha :white_check_mark:
